high_level_description: The image features a woman standing in front of a backdrop with the text "NATIONAL BOARD OF REVIEW" repeated multiple times. She is wearing an elegant black strapless gown with intricate detailing and a deep neckline. The dress has a fitted silhouette that accentuates her figure. She accessorizes with a bracelet on her left wrist and a ring on her right hand. Her hair is styled in loose waves, cascading over her shoulders. The setting appears to be a formal event or awards ceremony, given the backdrop and her attire.
